body:
Collision reconciliation - this claim announced work that had already shipped. The line resumed from a stale local checkout (tip f7a92d41), read office memory from that stale disk, and emitted the claim before any fetch; the first push was rejected non-fast-forward against parts 7-8, which had landed both builds the day before (7ec66569 item 1, 938b197e item 2; verified independently by Zuri S008, a4602ca7). No product code was written on this claim.

Converted to verification duty instead - all live, this sandbox, on the merged tip (rebase of the claim onto a4602ca7):
- Full backend suite 3707 passed / 2 skipped (canonical order) after repairing sandbox drift (sqlite-vec missing).
- scripts/live_test_provider_death_honesty.py PASS on an own run - provider named, payment_required verbatim, evidence delivered with terminal=true on the wire, no dead advice.
- scripts/live_test_identity_injection.py PASS on an own run - stated facts on both wires (fast path + loop), zone-named clock, declared-absent form, honest ask-back accepted zero-tool.
- Frontend targeted: ErrorMessage + errorText suites, 21 passed.

Verdict: both releases stand as shipped; claim closed with no product commit of its own, citing the two product commits it redundantly claimed.
